notes: The build is the vendor's build: Final setup builds exactly what the vendor's IDE project builds (every source, linked folders too, the include folders in order, defines, linker script, libraries), checked by Nova against the project itself; a path the project names is restored from the vendor's repository or reported as the vendor's own leftover, never silently skipped. Discovery is the last part of the Setup page; Pack makes a release zip with a Download button in the chat; tool ticks are instant; the bot is the one place to talk; when the board stays dark after a flash, Nova matches the IDE's build and flash and tries again.
